The output snippet didn't show full missing values per column; but the description says there are 2 nulls in flipper_length_mm. The answer's claim is unsupported.

4. UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: Missing values in flipper_length_mm (2) are ignored but not acknowledged. Also missing sex values irrelevant. So they ignored missing flipper_length_mm.
